credit: Computed at build time via the geocentric Lambert model (src/lib/lambert-geocentric.ts, ADR-085). Earth→Moon: 82% cells feasible (1977 of 11200 outside the short-way TOF band). ∆v = TLI (µ_Earth LEO departure) + LOI (patched-conic, µ_Moon).
